Nowhere Location Simulator is built strictly for software developers, QA test automation, geolocation feature verification, route simulation, privacy masking, and academic research.
The user is solely responsible for ensuring their usage conforms with the Terms of Service (ToS), EULAs, and community guidelines of any third-party apps, websites, games, or platforms.
Nowhere must NEVER be used in real-life automotive driving navigation, aviation, maritime navigation, or emergency services (such as 911, 112, or local dispatch).
Nowhere runs entirely on-device. We do not track, store, or share your real or simulated coordinates with any external party.
Device network traffic is secured inside our kernel WireGuard tunnel with Google BBR congestion control and TCP MSS Clamping to prevent leak detection.
Engages VPN on mock start; disengages on stop
Kernel WireGuard (UDP 51820): ChaCha20-Poly1305 encryption with cellular MTU 1280 to eliminate carrier fragmentation.
Google BBR Congestion Control: Zero-bufferbloat pacing prevents abnormal latency spikes flagged by anti-spoof systems.
TCP MSS Clamping (PMTU): Modifies SYN headers so sites and fraud detection engines cannot fingerprint tunnel packet sizes.
Encrypted DNS Shield: Routes 100% of DNS lookups through Cloudflare / Google (1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8) to stop local carrier ISP leaks.
